style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Frosted Cone Garland
style.toneOfVoice: Bring a touch of winter elegance into your home with this beautifully styled 153cm frosted white & cone garland. Inspired by snow-dusted woodland scenes, this garland features softly frosted greenery intertwined with natural-style pinecones for a look that feels both festive and refined. Its delicate white finish adds a light, airy charm, making it perfect for brightening mantels, staircases, door frames or dining tables. The combination of textured foliage and rustic cones creates depth and visual interest, allowing it to stand out effortlessly whether displayed on its own or enhanced with lights, ribbons or seasonal accents. Measuring 153cm in length, this garland is full and flexible, making it easy to shape and style to suit your space. Designed for long-lasting use, it stays looking fresh and beautifully arranged year after year, with no shedding or maintenance required. A timeless addition to your seasonal décor, this frosted garland brings the beauty of a winter landscape indoors with ease. Bring indoors during adverse weather conditions. Garland Length: L183cm.
